categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the construction industry, focusing on public infrastructure projects such as highways, rail transit systems, social housing, and urban renewal developments. It also engages in self-developed residential building projects and participates in BOT and turnkey construction contracts. The business segments include civil engineering, building construction, and urban redevelopment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced construction technologies including green building materials, smart construction site systems, and innovative construction methods to improve energy efficiency and reduce environmental impact. It integrates BIM (Building Information Modeling) and project management information systems (PMIS) for efficient project execution. Emphasis is placed on sustainable construction practices, safety management systems, and environmental pollution control measures.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are government agencies such as the Ministry of Transportation and Communications, Taipei City Government, New Taipei City Government, and the National Housing and Urban Renewal Center. The company serves public infrastructure sectors including highways, metro systems, social housing, and urban renewal projects. The market is predominantly public sector-driven with some private residential development.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan, with projects concentrated in Taipei, New Taipei, Kaohsiung, and other urban areas. It also has a wholly owned subsidiary in Singapore. The focus is on domestic infrastructure and urban development projects, with no overseas securities issuance reported.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream construction contractor, engaging in project bidding, construction management, and turnkey project delivery. It procures materials both domestically and internationally and manages subcontractors and suppliers. It does not appear to be involved in upstream raw material production or downstream retail sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding public infrastructure and urban renewal projects, adopting green and smart construction technologies, and enhancing ESG (Environmental, Social, Governance) practices. The company emphasizes sustainable development, climate risk management, and continuous improvement in construction quality and safety. It also plans to diversify through investments in forward-looking industries and strengthen alliances with financial and design firms.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through contract-based construction services, including public works contracts, turnkey projects, and BOT arrangements. The company earns income from project completion payments, with no subscription or licensing revenue reported. It also engages in property development sales for self-built residential projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include leading Taiwanese construction firms such as CTCI Corporation, Hsin Lu Construction, De Chang Construction, Tatshin Construction, and others. The company positions itself as a reputable mid-to-large scale contractor with over 50 years of experience, focusing on high-quality public infrastructure and urban renewal projects to maintain competitiveness against both domestic and foreign firms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company has a substantial scale with total assets exceeding NT$7.2 billion and annual revenues around NT$9.6 billion in the latest fiscal year. It has shown steady revenue growth and improved profitability, with net income increasing by over 25%. The equity attributable to owners grew by approximately 15.6%, reflecting a positive growth trajectory and financial stability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality construction standards, strict project selection focusing on high-profit and low-risk contracts, and strong ESG commitments including green building certifications and workplace safety. Its long-standing experience, integrated project management capabilities, and proactive climate risk strategies differentiate it in the competitive construction market. The company also prioritizes customer satisfaction through reliable project delivery and sustainable urban development.
